items.statement: Funds raised through preferential allotment last year were used for expansion and automation.
items.quote: So last year, we have raised the fund through the preferential alignment and we have utilized that fund for the further expansion as well.

items.statement: Collection efficiency for current and up to 30 days past due improved to 99.4% in March 2025 from 97.3% in December 2024.
items.quote: Our overall collection efficiency, including current and up to 30 days past due, improved to 99.4% in March 2025, which is definitely the best in the industry, up from 97.3% in December 2024.

items.statement: Collection efficiency for current and up to 90 days past due rose to 98.4% in March 2025 from 95.2% in December 2024.
items.quote: Similarly, collection efficiency for current and up to 90 days past due rose to 98.4% in March, compared to 95.2% in December, again among the best in the industry, highlighting consistent progress in our recovery efforts.

items.statement: Net worth will significantly improve with INR85 crores pending from the issue of share warrants.
items.quote: Net worth will significantly improve this year as well as INR85 crores in pending from the issue of share warrants.

name: Shri Keshav Cements And Infra Ltd

items.statement: Equity dilution is not a problem if it ultimately gives wealth to all stakeholders.
items.quote: dilution is not a problem as long as it ultimately gives wealth to all the stakeholders

items.statement: Promoter Udit Rathi appointed as Chief Strategy Officer; father Pradeep Rathi and Udit Rathi guide company; professional team manages daily operations
items.quote: The company has appointed me as the Chief Strategy Officer, wherein my role will be to look at only basically growth opportunities and guide the team.

items.statement: Promoters hold 90-93% stake after restructuring in June 2023
items.quote: In June 2023, the shareholding has been restructured, and currently the promoters hold about 90 to 93% of the holding, which is significant.

items.statement: Shareholder approval obtained for QIP of around 8,200 crores
items.quote: We are looking at raising somewhere around 8,200 crores in the queue.

items.statement: OFS underway to reduce promoter holding from 95% to 90% per SEBI requirement
items.quote: This OFS was done because of a regulatory requirement, whereas per SEBI conditions we have to reduce our shareholding from 95 to 90.

items.statement: Operating on self-funding mode with no bank borrowings; working capital lines being raised
items.quote: The company has got practically no bank borrowings today, and for the last few years it has been operating only on a self-funding mode.

items.statement: Internal controls strengthened with external consultants and increased board oversight
items.quote: Those internal controls are being, have been strengthened and are continuously being strengthened. Considerable help is being taken from outside consultants also to enhance internal controls compliance, and the board oversight has also been increased significantly.

items.statement: Debtor days are high at year-end due to government orders with 60-90 day payment cycles
items.quote: Majority of our debtors are government debtors. So in March end , those order comes and payment comes in 60 days to 90 days.

items.statement: Target to reduce debt below 10% of annual turnover supported by improved operating cash flows and monetization of surplus assets from plant consolidation
items.quote: Our target is to reduce debt to below 10% of annual turnover, supported by improved operating cash flows, and monetization of surplus assets, including from the plant consolidation.

items.statement: Promoters infused capital via preferential issue of 2 lakh shares
items.quote: To further support our operations and growth initiative, promoters have infused additional capital into the company through a preferential issue of 2 lakh shares.

items.statement: Inventory at 50% of desired base level as of March 2025; building base inventory of 75-80 days production
items.quote: As of March '25, we were not adequately stocked because we have just started increasing our inventories. The inventory level is right now at 50% of what we desire.

items.statement: Top 60-70% revenue from general trade on cash-and-carry model; institutional customers have 3-30 day credit terms
items.quote: Again, the top 60%-70% of our revenue comes from general trade where there is no credit terms with them. It's a cash and carry model that we work with.

items.statement: No fundraise planned for FY26; well funded on equity and debt aligned for FY26 working capital
items.quote: No, we do not see any fundraise requirements. Honestly, from an equity perspective, the company is well funded. From a debt perspective, again, we have already planned for FY '26 and we have already aligned ourselves from that perspective.

items.statement: Provision of INR6.5 crore for Satpuda Sakhar receivable; confident of recovery due to debtor assets and court acknowledgment
items.quote: It is not INR12 crores. It was INR6.5 crores which is as of March outstanding. See, we are confident purely because we are -- the debtors here have significant assets available in case we have to go for liquidations of the assets.

items.statement: Working capital limits sufficient for entire FY26; rated BBB stable by CRISIL with multinational and private lenders
items.quote: It is sufficient enough for us to look at FY '26 entire working capital requirement. That is already something which I have already communicated. Just to give you again back, we have a pool of multinational banks with us as well as top-class private lenders in India.

items.statement: Receivables are within control and being realized within 6 months
items.quote: stock level is going down , the sales we have made , receivables are within control, they are all being realized within 6 months.

items.statement: Trade receivables doubled to Rs 6.5 crore and are over 110 days due to March invoicing of ~Rs 5 crore and a Rs 1.9 crore order paid next month
items.quote: So, in the March month. Only, if you see we have done the invoicing of some. I don't remember 5 crores approximately so. Those payments will come in April-May. Already some payments have come, 50% remaining is coming

items.statement: Inventory grew from zero to Rs 2.5 crore to support hardware AMC spare parts for repair and return
items.quote: So, from 0 to 15.23 crores, we are managing an inventory of 2 and a half crores. I think this. This answers your question.

items.statement: Equity capital increased from Rs 4.32 crore to Rs 4.45 crore due to preferential allotment
items.quote: This is the balance sheet from last year. This is the equity capital has increased from 4.32 to 4.45, reserves and surplus have increased from 305 to 1378

items.statement: Management says working capital was funded by IPO proceeds received in January and payments are collected within 25-30 days maximum after bill submission.
items.quote: To manage the working capital was the reason that we had gone for the IPO last December. So, we got our funds in January. So, it was not very difficult to manage since then. And still because the payments are not stuck anywhere. So, we can say that once the payment is -- so once the bill is made and presented to either private client or say government client, our payments get done by say 25 days,

items.statement: Depreciation of Rs. 2.3 crores and interest of Rs. 1.5-1.55 crores from subsidiary will impact consolidated results from Q1 FY26
items.value: Rs. 2.3 crores depreciation and Rs. 1.5-1.55 crores interest
items.quote: However, going forward, we see that depreciation would hit us by about Rs. 2.3 crores and interest of about Rs. 1.5 to Rs. 1.55 crores from the subsidiary company giving an impact to the consolidated balance sheet.

items.statement: Receivable days increased to 70-75 days from 40-43 days due to working capital rebalancing and exponential growth; inventory days have fallen.
items.quote: Our receivable days have gone from 40, 43 days to around 70, 75 days. So, what exactly are we not able to negotiate with our suppliers or what is driving this increase in receivable days?

items.statement: Most debtors are CRISIL A rated and above, many AA and AAA; receivables can be discounted quickly at fair rates.
items.quote: Without taking names, I can tell you that most of our debtors are, they're CRISIL A rated and above. Many are AA and some are, many of them are also AAA.

items.statement: Fund flow is very positive; all profit generated is in the form of current assets convertible to cash quickly.
items.quote: Fund flow, which is a real critical way to analyze, I feel personally, again humbly so, the fund flow statements if one has to draw from a company, they would be very, very positive.

items.statement: Working capital requirement is inherent and will grow with revenue; cannot be eliminated, only optimized.
items.quote: If my revenue has to increase at a certain pace, there has to be growth in my current assets.

items.statement: Fundraise plan is under discussion with the board and committees; no decision yet.
items.quote: So, sir, we are still internally discussing this with the board and the committees. So, on that one, we'll get back to you as and when we do plan that.

items.statement: Receivables of Rs 10.5 crore as of March 2025; Rs 4 crore already received, Rs 2.5 crore in final release stage, rest expected in a quarter
items.quote: Sir, out of 10 crore we have already received 4 crore. 2.5 crore is in the final stage of release and rest will be released in say a quarter.

items.statement: Receivables increased to INR13 crores due to January intake commissions in process; this is a recurring annual cycle
items.quote: If you see, these numbers are always there because there is an intake which happens in the month of January. There are majorly, internationally, there are three intakes, right. So one of the major intake is January, January numbers. So all those commissions are basically, you can say, in the kind of a process. So that is why those are reccivables. These arc almost every year, these are there

items.statement: IPO raised INR40 crores; deployment over approximately 18 months from date of issue for branch openings, advertisements, branding, and acquisitions
items.quote: So as mentioned in the DRHP, it will take approximately 18 months for us to deploy the entire funds, because most of these funds would be deployed in opening the branches, as well as advertisements and branding exercises. There is one object which is in the acquisition. We are in very advanced stage of basically acquiring acquisition of colleges and one of the broker is one of the immigration cons

items.statement: Acquisition targets include an Indian college and a regional immigration consultant; advanced discussions ongoing but not finalized
items.quote: No, no Indian entity only. We are looking at two spaces, basically one acquisition of the college, Indian college, domestic college, and acquisition of a regional player like us.
